 =============================================================================
 This file defines the base configuration schema for the getHarsh ecosystem.
 All domains, blogs, and projects inherit from these defaults.

 Key Concepts:
 - Ecosystem-wide defaults that apply to all entities
 - Environment variable management with security classification
 - Schema.org entity configuration for rich semantic markup
 - Policy pages with hierarchical override capability

 Related Documentation:
 - Implementation: ../ecosystem-defaults.yml
 - Schema.org Guide: ../SCHEMA-ORG-EXAMPLES.md
